title: Negative-text corpus (false-positive-rate measurement)
description: Deterministic corpus of realistic benign documents that contain no valid PII. Scored through the same PIIDetector.detect path as the G8 corpus; any surfaced detection is, by construction, a false positive. The content deliberately seeds the context-mandatory detector families' trigger-keywords (account, phone, MRN, EIN, ITIN, routing) in innocent non-PII contexts. Dev/eval fixture, not a shipped resource; read by the Swift baseline harness from Fixtures/corpus/negative_corpus.json. License-clean: no SSN-shaped strings, no standalone 9-digit numbers, no valid-checksum identifiers, phones (if any) only in the reserved 555-01xx range, RFC-2606 domains only, no real org/brand names, 100% printable ASCII, byte-deterministic.

version.description: Wire-format version. V1 is the only version.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: Recorded for uniformity; this builder is not randomized, so the documents are independent of the seed value.

documents.description: All-negative document set. No ground-truth PII spans: every document is benign prose, so any detection is a false positive.

id.description: Stable document id, zero-padded to six digits (neg_000000 ...).

doctype.description: Document class; mirrors the G8 corpus / S3 contract doctype enum.

text.description: Benign prose paragraph containing no valid PII.
